description: An interactive Career Break Cost tool: for a number of months off, the take-home given up, the pension not paid in, what that pension would have grown to by retirement, and what it means for their State Pension record, with sliders for the months and the pension. Starts from Budget's take-home and their Retirement overview, with labelled examples for anything missing. Use for 'what would a year off cost me', 'can I afford a sabbatical', 'what does parental leave cost my pension'.

monthlyPensionContribution.description: Paid into the pension a month, theirs and their employer's. In pounds. Leave out to start from their own figures in Foliopeak.

monthlyTakeHome.description: Take-home pay a month. In pounds. Leave out to start from their own figures in Foliopeak.

monthsOff.description: Months away from work. Defaults to 12.

yearsToRetirement.description: Years from now to retirement. Leave out to work it out from their age.

name: get_career_break_cost
title: Career Break Cost
